caveat: High for players who shoot through crowds. Not a save.

label: Carries
definition: Times the player moved the ball with their feet rather than passing it.
coverage_note: First appears 2019-20 for stray players, missing entirely in 2020-21 and 2022-23, not league-wide until 2024-25. Treat earlier seasons as missing, not zero. Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Not populated league-wide until 2024-25. 2020-21 and 2022-23 have no carries at all. Do not back-fill.

label: Carry rate
definition: Carries divided by touches. How often a touch becomes a carry.
caveat: Needs 200 touches. Carries are not league-wide until 2024-25; 2020-21 and 2022-23 are missing entirely.

label: Clean sheets (Opta)
definition: Matches Opta recorded as a clean sheet for this player.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Opta's minutes rule may differ from FPL's 60-minute threshold. Do not mix with FPL clean sheets.

label: Goal-line clearances
definition: Clearances off the line, preventing a goal.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Rare. Do not rank on it.

label: Clearance share of defending
definition: Effective clearances as a fraction of the same defensive pool.
caveat: High for last-line defenders. NULL if the pool is empty.

label: Cross accuracy
definition: Completed crosses divided by attempted crosses. NULL if none were attempted.
coverage_note: NULL when the denominator is zero. Pulse season grain only.
caveat: Low for almost everyone. A 30% rate is already high.

label: Cross share
definition: Crosses as a fraction of all passes.
caveat: Wide-deliverer shape. Needs 200 passes.

label: Dispossessed
definition: Times the player was tackled in possession and lost the ball.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Wingers who dribble a lot will rank high. Not a passing turnover.

label: Diving saves
definition: Saves Opta tagged as diving.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A subset of saves. Spectacular, not necessarily higher leverage than a standing save.

label: Duels lost
definition: 50-50s Opta recorded as lost.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Read with duels won. A high loss count with a high win count is volume, not failure.

label: Duel win rate
definition: Duels won divided by duels won plus lost. NULL if the player had no duels.
coverage_note: NULL when the denominator is zero. Pulse season grain only.
caveat: A 60% rate in 10 duels is not the same as 60% in 200.

label: Duels won
definition: Ground and aerial 50-50s Opta recorded as won.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Winning lots of duels can mean you were in lots of duels — often a press or a long-ball side, not a 'better' player.

label: Effective clearances
definition: Clearances Opta judged to have actually relieved pressure.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Inflated for defenders under siege. total_clearance is the rawer count.

label: Errors leading to a goal
definition: Mistakes Opta judged led directly to a goal.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Subjective and rare. A high-usage defender will have more chances to error.

label: Errors leading to a shot
definition: Mistakes Opta judged led to a shot.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Broader than errors leading to a goal, still rare and labelled.

label: Final-third entries
definition: Times the player carried or passed the ball into the attacking third.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: An entry is not a chance. High for ball-progressors, wide or central.

label: Final-third touch share
definition: Final-third touches as a fraction of all touches.
caveat: Needs 200 touches. Carries and final-third touches are not league-wide until 2024-25.

label: Fouls committed
definition: Fouls this player committed.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A discipline and a defending-style signal. Not the same as yellow cards.

label: Forward passes
definition: Passes Opta classified as travelling toward the opposition goal, regardless of whether they were completed.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Direction, not progress. A forward pass can still be played in the defensive third.

label: Forward pass share
definition: Forward passes as a fraction of all passes. A shape signal: how often the player looks up the pitch.
caveat: Needs 200 passes or it is left blank. High for deep progressors; low for wingers who play backward into feet.

label: Forward-zone pass share
definition: Passes struck from the attacking half, as a fraction of all passes.
caveat: Where the player stands more than how they pass. Needs 200 passes.

label: Assists (Opta)
definition: Assists Opta credited — typically the last pass before the goal under Opta rules.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Stricter than FPL assists on rebounds. Do not mix with the FPL assist column.

label: Goal kicks
definition: Goal kicks taken.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Distribution volume. Accuracy is accurate_goal_kicks, which is archive-adjacent unless shipped.

label: Goals (Opta)
definition: Goals Opta credited. Own goals are separate.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Can disagree with FPL on deflections. Use o_goals for football, goals for fantasy points.

label: Goals conceded (Opta)
definition: Goals conceded while this player was on the pitch, by Opta.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Team-quality signal. Can disagree with FPL on timing of substitutions.

label: High claims
definition: Crosses the keeper came and caught cleanly, as Opta judged 'good'.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: The companion to punches. Opta's 'good' label is unpublished.

label: Handballs
definition: Handball offences Opta recorded.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Not all are bookings. Rare as a ranking stat.

label: Headed passes
definition: Passes played with the head.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Centre-backs and target forwards accumulate these. Not aerial duels.

label: Headed shot share
definition: Headed shots as a fraction of all shots.
caveat: NULL if no shots. Aerial attackers vs ground shooters.

label: Hit woodwork
definition: Shots that struck the post or bar.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Rare. Do not rank on it.

label: Inside-box shot share
definition: Inside-the-box shots as a fraction of all shots.
caveat: NULL if the player took no shots. A poacher vs a long-shot profile.

label: Interceptions
definition: Passes Opta recorded this player as intercepting.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: High for players in passing lanes, often in a mid or low block. Not FPL's CBI interception slice.

label: Interceptions won
definition: Interceptions that ended with this player in possession.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: The successful subset of interception. A cut-out that bounces away may sit only on interception.

label: Keeper pick-ups
definition: Times the keeper picked up a loose back-pass or similar, rather than claiming a cross.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Routine. High totals follow minutes more than skill.

label: Last-man tackles
definition: Tackles Opta tagged as last-man (covering a through ball or break).
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Rare and context-heavy. A missed last-man tackle is a different field.

label: Long-ball share
definition: Long balls as a fraction of all passes.
caveat: Direct-play shape, not accuracy. Needs 200 passes.

label: Long passes into the opposition half
definition: Long passes that started in the player's own half and were aimed into the opposition half.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A direct-play signal. Completion is in the companion field.

label: Successful long passes into the opposition half
definition: Those long passes that reached a teammate.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A completed long ball up the pitch, not necessarily a chance.

label: Loss rate
definition: Dispossessed plus unsuccessful touches, per touch.
caveat: Needs 200 touches. High for players who try things in tight spaces.

label: Shots on target
definition: Shots on target, including goals.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: The numerator of shot accuracy. Does not say how good the chances were.

label: Open-play passes
definition: Passes attempted from open play, excluding set pieces.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Most of total_pass. Useful when you want to ignore corners and free kicks.

label: Box touch share
definition: Opposition-box touches as a fraction of all touches.
caveat: Needs 200 touches.

label: Blocks
definition: Shots blocked by this outfielder.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Centre-backs in a low block accumulate these. Not a keeper save.

label: Own goals (Opta)
definition: Own goals Opta credited.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Deflections are the usual disagreement with FPL.

label: Pass accuracy
definition: Completed passes divided by attempted passes. NULL if the player attempted none.
coverage_note: NULL when the denominator is zero. Pulse season grain only.
caveat: Easy to inflate with safe passes. Clustering leaves this out because it is quality, not shape.

label: Pass share of team
definition: The player's passes as a fraction of their club's passes that season.
coverage_note: NULL before 2020-21 (no GW team_code) and NULL for mid-season club movers.
caveat: NULL if they changed club mid-season — the Pulse row cannot be split. Not a mover approximation.

label: Penalty-area entries
definition: Times the player carried or passed the ball into the opposition box.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Closer to chance creation than final-third entries, but still not a shot.

label: Penalties saved (Opta)
definition: Penalties Opta recorded as saved.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Rare. FPL penalties_saved is the fantasy figure.

label: Penalties won
definition: Penalties awarded after a foul on this player, as Opta recorded it.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Not the same as penalties taken or scored. Rare.

label: Possessions lost
definition: All ways of giving the ball away, as Opta totals them.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Volume follows touches. Per-touch loss rate is the style signal, not the raw count.

label: Possessions won in the attacking third
definition: Balls won back in the final third. The numerator of press height.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A high press signal. Low totals can mean a low block, not laziness.

label: Possessions won in the defensive third
definition: Balls won back in the defensive third.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: High for a low block. The denominator of press height with the other two thirds.

label: Possessions won in the middle third
definition: Balls won back in midfield.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: The middle slice of press height.

label: Press height
definition: Possessions won in the attacking third as a fraction of possessions won in all thirds.
caveat: A high-press vs low-block shape. NULL if the player won the ball nowhere.

label: Progressive carries
definition: Carries that move the ball a meaningful distance toward the opposition goal. Opta's distance threshold is not published.
coverage_note: Same coverage as carries: stray values from 2019-20, holes in 2020-21 and 2022-23, not league-wide until 2024-25. Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Same 2024-25 coverage boundary as carries. Without the threshold, do not over-interpret small differences.

label: Progressive carry share
definition: Progressive carries as a fraction of carries.
caveat: Needs 200 touches and a non-zero carry count. Same 2024-25 boundary as carries.

label: Punches
definition: Crosses or balls the keeper punched clear.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A claiming style. High punches with low claims is a punching keeper, not a better one.

label: Recovery share of defending
definition: Ball recoveries as a fraction of the same defensive pool.
caveat: High for scavengers rather than tacklers. NULL if the pool is empty.

label: Red cards (Opta)
definition: Dismissals Opta recorded.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Rare. FPL reds are the fantasy figure.

label: Saves (Opta)
definition: Shots Opta recorded this keeper as saving.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: High for keepers who face more shots. Read with o_goals_conceded, not as a ranking of quality alone.

label: Second yellow cards
definition: Dismissals via a second yellow.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A subset of reds. Rare.

label: Shot accuracy
definition: Shots on target divided by shots. NULL if the player took none.
coverage_note: NULL when the denominator is zero. Pulse season grain only.
caveat: Does not say how good the chances were. A tap-in and a 30-yard drive both count as on or off.

label: Shots off target
definition: Shots that missed the frame without being blocked.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Includes wild efforts and narrow misses. Pair with on target, not with xG.

label: Shot share of team
definition: The player's shots as a fraction of their club's shots.
coverage_note: NULL before 2020-21 (no GW team_code) and NULL for mid-season club movers.
caveat: NULL for mid-season movers. A focal-point signal.

label: Shots per touch
definition: Shots divided by touches. How shoot-first the player is.
caveat: Needs 200 touches. Forwards will dominate; that is shape, not finishing.

label: Successful final-third passes
definition: Completed passes in the attacking third.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Completion in this zone is harder than at the back; still not a chance-creation stat.

label: Successful open-play passes
definition: Completed open-play passes.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Same caution as accurate_pass: volume follows possession.

label: Tackle share of defending
definition: Tackles as a fraction of tackles + interceptions + clearances + recoveries.
caveat: How the player defends, not how much. NULL if that pool is empty.

label: Take-on rate
definition: Take-ons attempted per touch.
caveat: Needs 200 touches. The dribbler signal.

label: Take-on success
definition: Completed take-ons over attempted take-ons.
coverage_note: Excluded from clustering because it measures quality, not shape.
caveat: Quality, not shape — excluded from clustering. NULL if no take-ons.

label: Through-ball share
definition: Through balls as a fraction of all passes.
caveat: Rare events on a large denominator. Needs 200 passes.

label: Times tackled
definition: Times this player was tackled by an opponent.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: High for dribblers. The other side of won_tackle.

label: Shot assists
definition: Passes that led directly to a teammate's shot, on or off target.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Broader than Opta assists and broader than big chances created. A shot assist is not an expected assist.

label: Back-zone passes
definition: Passes attempted from the defensive half.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Centre-backs and deep midfielders accumulate these by default.

label: Chipped passes
definition: Passes Opta recorded as chipped (lifted over a defender or line).
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Opta's chip definition is unpublished. Not the same as a through ball.

label: Clearances
definition: All clearances attempted.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Same pressure bias as effective_clearance. Not FPL CBI.

label: Take-ons attempted
definition: Dribbles / 1v1s attempted. The Opta field is total_contest.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Wingers live here. Attempt volume is a style signal; success rate is quality and is not used in clustering.

label: Crosses
definition: Open-play and set-piece crosses attempted, including corners in some Opta flavours of this field.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: High for wide players and overlapping full-backs. Completion is usually low; volume is the style signal.

label: Final-third passes
definition: Passes attempted in the attacking third.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Team-possession dependent. A deep-lying playmaker on a cautious side may look quiet.

label: Forward-zone passes
definition: Passes attempted from the attacking half of the pitch.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Where the pass was struck, not where it arrived.

label: Sweeper-keeper actions
definition: Times the keeper left their box to intercept or clear, as Opta recorded them.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A style signal. Failed sweepers sit on related fields, not as negative here.

label: Long balls
definition: Passes Opta classified as long, attempted. Includes switches and clearances played as passes.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Opta's distance cut-off is not published. Do not treat as 'accurate long passing' without the accurate companion.

label: Offsides
definition: Times the player was caught offside.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A movement and timing tell for forwards. Team line and referee style both sit inside it.

label: Total passes
definition: Every pass attempted, including short balls in defence and unsuccessful ones. Not a measure of quality; see pass accuracy.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Tracks minutes and team possession more than passing skill. A holding midfielder on a dominant side will lead the league.

label: Shots
definition: All shots recorded, including blocked, off target and goals. Opta's total_scoring_att.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A blocked shot still counts. Volume follows role more than finishing.

label: Tackles (Opta)
definition: Tackles Opta recorded. This is the football count, not FPL's defensive-contribution tackle.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Will not match FPL tackles. Use this in the Defensive / football view; use FPL tackles only where points were scored.

label: Through balls
definition: Passes Opta labelled as through balls — typically splitting the last line.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Opta's label is unpublished in detail. Rare; a handful of players dominate the count.

label: Touch share of team
definition: The player's touches as a fraction of their club's touches.
coverage_note: NULL before 2020-21 (no GW team_code) and NULL for mid-season club movers.
caveat: NULL for mid-season movers. High for metronomes on dominant sides.

label: Touches
definition: Times the player had the ball, by Opta's touch definition. The usual volume denominator for carry and take-on rates.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Follows minutes and team possession. A 90-minute centre-back on a dominant side can out-touch a winger.

label: Final-third touches
definition: Touches in the attacking third.
coverage_note: First appears 2019-20 for stray players; not league-wide until 2024-25. Treat earlier seasons as missing, not zero. Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Not populated league-wide until 2024-25. Earlier seasons have stray players only; treat pre-2024-25 as missing, not zero.

label: Opposition-box touches
definition: Touches inside the opponent's penalty area.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Forwards and attacking full-backs. A box touch is not a shot.

label: Turnovers
definition: Possessions lost in situations Opta labels a turnover.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Opta's split versus poss_lost_all is unpublished. Use as a flavour of loss, not a second ranking.

label: Unsuccessful touches
definition: Touches Opta recorded as miscontrolled — the player had the ball and immediately lost it without being tackled.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: High for players who receive under pressure. Pair with dispossessed for on-the-ball losses.

label: Fouled
definition: Times an opponent fouled this player.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Dribblers and players who receive between the lines draw fouls. Not a diving count.

label: Take-ons completed
definition: Take-ons Opta recorded as beaten.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: A completed take-on is not a chance. Pair with box touches and shots.

label: Tackles won
definition: Tackles Opta recorded as successful (possession won or the ball going out from the tackle).
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: The gap between total_tackle and won_tackle is failed tackles, not fouls — those sit in attempted_tackle_foul.

label: Yellow cards (Opta)
definition: Bookings Opta recorded.
coverage_note: Pulse season totals. Verbatim API; omitted zeros stay NULL.
caveat: Can disagree with FPL on timing. Use FPL yellows for points.

label: Own goals adjusted per 90
definition: The adjusted per-90 of own goals. See adjusted_per_90 for the formula and the fitted k.
caveat: FPL and Opta sometimes disagree on deflections. Rare; do not rank on per-90.

label: Own goals per 90
definition: The own goals total divided by minutes and scaled to 90. The frontend derives this itself from the season total and minutes; the mart stores the same formula.
caveat: FPL and Opta sometimes disagree on deflections. Rare; do not rank on per-90.

label: Penalties missed adjusted per 90
definition: The adjusted per-90 of penalties missed. See adjusted_per_90 for the formula and the fitted k.
caveat: FPL deducts points. A single miss is a large swing on a thin sample.

label: Penalties missed per 90
definition: The penalties missed total divided by minutes and scaled to 90. The frontend derives this itself from the season total and minutes; the mart stores the same formula.
caveat: FPL deducts points. A single miss is a large swing on a thin sample.

label: Penalties saved adjusted per 90
definition: The adjusted per-90 of penalties saved. See adjusted_per_90 for the formula and the fitted k.
caveat: Rare. A season with one save will dominate any per-90 ranking; the adjusted rate exists to damp that.

label: Penalties saved per 90
definition: The penalties saved total divided by minutes and scaled to 90. The frontend derives this itself from the season total and minutes; the mart stores the same formula.
caveat: Rare. A season with one save will dominate any per-90 ranking; the adjusted rate exists to damp that.

label: Percentile
definition: Rank position expressed 0–100 against same-position players clearing the minutes floor, on the adjusted rate.
derived_from: percentile rank of adjusted_per_90 within (season, position) after the minutes floor
coverage_note: Computed in the frontend against the current filtered set, not stored in the marts.
caveat: A 90th percentile in a 12-player filter is not the same claim as in the whole league. Direction is already applied: 100 is always 'good'.

label: Recoveries adjusted per 90
definition: The adjusted per-90 of recoveries. See adjusted_per_90 for the formula and the fitted k.
coverage_note: Present 2016-17 to 2018-19, absent 2019-20 through 2024-25, back from 2025-26. Do not fill the hole from Opta ball recoveries.
caveat: Same 2019-24 hole as tackles. Opta ball recoveries (o_ball_recovery) are not a substitute.

label: Recoveries per 90
definition: The recoveries total divided by minutes and scaled to 90. The frontend derives this itself from the season total and minutes; the mart stores the same formula.
coverage_note: Present 2016-17 to 2018-19, absent 2019-20 through 2024-25, back from 2025-26. Do not fill the hole from Opta ball recoveries.
caveat: Same 2019-24 hole as tackles. Opta ball recoveries (o_ball_recovery) are not a substitute.

label: Recoveries share of team
definition: This player's recoveries as a proportion of the club's total in the same matches. See share_of_team.
derived_from: player recoveries / team recoveries over GWs at the club
coverage_note: NULL before 2020-21 (no GW team_code) and NULL for players who changed club mid-season.
caveat: NULL for players who changed club mid-season.

label: Red cards adjusted per 90
definition: The adjusted per-90 of red cards. See adjusted_per_90 for the formula and the fitted k.
caveat: Rare. Per-90 rankings on one red are not meaningful.

label: Red cards per 90
definition: The red cards total divided by minutes and scaled to 90. The frontend derives this itself from the season total and minutes; the mart stores the same formula.
caveat: Rare. Per-90 rankings on one red are not meaningful.

label: Saves adjusted per 90
definition: The adjusted per-90 of saves. See adjusted_per_90 for the formula and the fitted k.
caveat: High for keepers in weak teams, who face more shots. Read alongside expected goals conceded.

label: Saves per 90
definition: The saves total divided by minutes and scaled to 90. The frontend derives this itself from the season total and minutes; the mart stores the same formula.
caveat: High for keepers in weak teams, who face more shots. Read alongside expected goals conceded.

label: Share of team
definition: The player's output as a proportion of their club's total in the same matches. NULL for players who changed club mid-season.
derived_from: player total / club total over the gameweeks the player was registered at that club
coverage_note: NULL before 2020-21 (no GW team_code) and NULL for players who changed club mid-season.
caveat: A mid-season move cannot be split on the Pulse row either: Opta team shares are also NULL for movers. Do not approximate.

label: Starts
definition: Matches FPL recorded as started (named in the XI).
coverage_note: vaastav merged_gw carries FPL GW stats when no live file exists; event/{gw}/live/ wins for a (season, gw) that has a file
caveat: A start can still be a 45-minute half. Pair with minutes and appearances.

label: Style cluster
definition: Nine playing-style archetypes from a single k-means fit on 2019-20 onward (effectively 2024-25 and 2025-26, when carries exist league-wide). 0 Generalist — no dimension above ±0.15, balanced, low-volume. 1 Wide deliverer — crosses, forward-zone passes. 2 Between the lines — backward passes, losses, progressive carries, box touches. 3 Aerial defender — headed shots, clearances, aerials. 4 Shooter — shot share, shots per touch, box touches. 5 Dribbler — take-ons, box touches, final-third touches. 6 Deep recycler — forward and long passes, low final third, low losses. 7 Progressive distributor — forward passes, long balls, through balls, high touch share. 8 Ball-playing defender — aerial-defender profile plus high team pass and touch share. Keepers and managers are not clustered.
derived_from: k-means (k=9) on z-scored style ratios, fit once on complete outfield cases
